```python
import os
import csv
from cyhole import SolanaFM

api_key = os.getenv("SOLANA_FM_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("SOLANA_FM_API_KEY environment variable not set")

fm = SolanaFM(api_key=api_key)

account = "9B5X4b4d97PCVXn4czysqMFfFQqGUcAesRj1kmtzzf5J"
transfers = fm.get_transfers(account)

with open("transfers_report.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    if transfers:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=transfers[0].keys())
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(transfers)
        print(f"Exported {len(transfers)} transfers to transfers_report.csv")
    else:
        print("No transfers found")
```
